scope: Proposition 7.4 (Uniform global continuation) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-with-local-conservation-for-the-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640850bc08703544), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The construction parameters can be fixed so that every dormant finite evolution and every cap solution with 0 < T ≤ T0 continues globally. There are constants B < ∞ and κ > 0, independent of N, bN ≥ 1, and T, such that ∥w(t)∥H ≤ B, νbN F (t, x, v) ≥ κ, t ≥ t1. (7.30) Every active jet satisfies (7.15) through its retirement, the total retirement increment is bounded by (7.18), and the hot component satisfies the small bound of Theorem 6.5 on [0, t1].
